column1: # EXPERIMENTAL integration clone: the two-key shader tables of first-runtime-pair with the Mac-only wide address
# range (mem_reserve 0x1100000000, mem_alias 0x1000000000); stack and app_pool unchanged. Not production, not iOS.
# EXPERIMENTAL clone for the two-key offline build (first runtime pair). NOT production, NOT iOS.
# Same identity/memory keys as the baseline, including the explicit zero NVN bases placeholder; only the shader tables differ.
# Provisional profile of Xenoblade Chronicles 3 (base title 010074F013262000, update 2.2.0), written from
# statically verifiable facts only. It lives outside the repository on purpose (DM_GAMES_DIR) and is NOT used for
# a production build. Every key below states its evidence; keys marked PROVISIONAL are guesses, not measurements.
# Sources: ExeFS of the extracted card at /path/to/external-drive/xc3/build/ExeFS, the RomFS manifest generated from
# /path/to/external-drive/xc3/build/RomFS (250 files), control.nacp, main.npdm, and dm/games/profile_guess.py.
# ---- Identity (verified) ----
# title id: the ACID inside main.npdm holds 0x010074F013262000 at ACID+0x10 (npdm ACID at 0x460, magic "ACID"),
# and nx_extract reports the same title from the card's NCA.
title_id
program_id
# name: the NACP in the card's control data (nx_extract prints "Xenoblade Chronicles 3")
name
ipa
app_category
# ---- Versions ----
# Build IDs of the four NSO modules as extracted from the card's update (verified).
#   The first field is the version label. 3 is the NCA header's Version field, which both the base and the update
#   Program NCA carry; the numeric title version itself was NOT independently established, so do not treat this
#   number as a measured title version. The display version 2.2.0 does come from the NACP (offset 0x3060).
# PROVISIONAL: the version label.
build
package
# shader_versions: only the update (2.2.0) is extracted, so the shader tables would come from it alone.
shader_versions
# ---- Modules ----
# profile_guess: "every module main imports from". main imports 448 dynamic symbols; sdk is nnSdk (26,897
# exports), subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie (10,895 exports), rtld is replaced by the host.
modules
# ---- Graphics ----
# main imports nvnBootstrapLoader, and the title's shaders live in SPCH ('HCPS') containers inside the RomFS
# archive /bf3.ard; dm/gfx/tools/spch.py reads them. Nothing here is a Vulkan title.
graphics
# Files ----
# the largest RomFS entry, 9,710,938,520 bytes (verified): the engine's archive body
romfs_marker
# ---- Shaders ----
# main holds 396 GLSLC outputs: the magic 0x19866891 appears 396 times and every one has a plausible total size at
# +0x44 (checked). profile_guess's rule reaches this key for the wrong reason (it states the RomFS has no BNSH /
# BAHS / UnityFS and concludes the shaders are compiled into main) - for this title the game's shaders are the
# SPCH containers instead, and these 396 are in addition to them.
shader_main_glslc
# PROVISIONAL: profile_guess's consequence of shader_main_glslc. Whether these 396 GLSLC programs are single-stage
# and combined per draw has not been measured for this title.
shader_separable
# ---- Memory partition (all PROVISIONAL) ----
# profile_guess derives these from "main never sets a heap (its memory is its own bss)": main's bss is 8.0 MB and
# the card's NPDM reports a 32 MB system resource. None of it was measured at run time, and no heap check was run.
mem_reserve
mem_alias
mem_stack
app_pool
# ---- Image table: EXPERIMENT ONLY (candidate, not a proof)
# The lighting pixel shader 4bae5b8abd3bec7f statically declares its image handle at c[2] byte 0x120
# (word 0x48). The runtime pre-draw snapshot for one observed draw had a sole candidate slot 0 and an NVN
# image register of 0; the actual value at c[2]+0x120 was NOT sampled. Stride 8 is an existing premise of
# the decoder, the bound descriptor was NVN format 0x0B = R32Uint (agreeing with the declared r32ui), and
# the range covers offset 0x120 / slot 0 for this experiment only. Texture slots and other constants are
# untouched.
# ---- NVN constants: texture base is a DERIVED HYPOTHESIS for this 14-key set only (see report 51):
# five PS programs have exactly one NVSD sampler with handle 0 and visibility Fragment, and the code handle word
# points at byte 0x20, so base 0x20 / slots 1 decode slot 0. Pending runtime verification; all other bases stay 0.
# ---- NVN constants: CPU-ONLY PLACEHOLDERS, NOT MEASURED XC3 FACTS ----
# The NVN driver-segment bases (texture / sampler / image handles, storage-buffer bases) are unknown for this
# title and were not measured. 0 means "unknown": nothing is borrowed from another title, and no shader fact is
# claimed. They exist only so the host header compiles for a headless CPU/memory bring-up, which has no shader
# libraries (DM_MSL_DIR empty) and exercises no graphics path. Replace with measurements before any graphics work.
# EXPERIMENT ONLY, not production and not a title-wide measurement: vertex storage-buffer table base 0x110 (unchanged
# from ssbo-vs110-correct645) and pixel storage-buffer table base 0x510 (this candidate; provenance below).
# Static constraints behind the vertex hypothesis: raw sbuf offsets 0x110/0x120/0x130 for VS; NVSD U_Instance handle 0
# (Slct175 p0) and U_SKIP handle 2 (Slct10 p2/p3, one buffer in p3); report80's three non-zero slots stay ambiguous. This
# does not change any NVSD semantics and does not borrow the Mario comment.
# PS 0x510 is report89's conditional constraint, NOT a measurement: the two PS programs read sbufs at 0x510 (shd_post
# slct146 p0 8c8d676f2d2bab80: one sbuf, NVSD has exactly one storage buffer with handle 0), at 0x510/0x520/0x530
# (shd_lgt slct0 p17 0104dd056a3b1902: NVSD storage buffers handle 0/1/2), and the reused shd_layout slct10 p2 PS has
# 0x510/0x520 against handles 0/1/2 while its VS 0x130 maps to handle 2 under vs=0x110. The NVSD handle -> NVN register
# mapping is still UNMEASURED; 0x510 is a candidate base, not a measured table address. The runtime-only key
# 304f1f866df79c3a (offsets 0x510..0x550) has no located SPCH source/NVSD, so this formula covers it only by arithmetic,
# not by metadata. Not title-wide, not production. CS stays 0.
nvn_ssbo_bases
nvn_tex_base
# EXPERIMENT ONLY (tex27 campaign): texture slot table widened from 16 to 27 so the observed handles 0x28..0x3C
# (bytes 0xA0..0xF0 under base 0x20, stride 8) decode to slots 16..26. This is the minimum range covering the highest
# observed formula slot 26; the 20 keys carrying these bindings have no NVSD support, and the existing base/stride
# premise plus continuity do NOT prove the real title table. No other domain constant is borrowed, no GS/fout change.
nvn_tex_slots
nvn_samp_base
nvn_img_base
nvn_img_slots
